variant.briefing:
Hey,

Outlaws have been targeting CFP supply caches and we’re sick of it. We started hiding trackers in the cargo containers and some just got lifted and taken to [Location].

Can you head there, get back what’s ours, and then take it to [Destination]?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. 

Thanks, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
